description: In every PA-model, the history at zero is the empty list.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history_zero_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {n : ℕ} (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value
      (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)) =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
